RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Both you and the successful candidate are women; nothing you describe specifically points to sex influencing the decision.

Your qualifications justify asking how the published criteria were applied, but paper counts and PhD status may not outweigh relevant industry experience or interview performance.

Follow up now requesting the written reasons, assessment criteria, and any available scoring or feedback. Check whether a completed PhD was essential and whether review or appeal deadlines are approaching; don’t assume waiting for a reply pauses them.

Raise specific procedural inconsistencies if they emerge—not the panel’s sex composition alone.
